title: India company details: registrations saved in the same save as a time-zone change are read back at once (the version is dated in the new zone, not the old one)

Recurring documents: an India company cannot mark a recurring invoice line taxable or apply GST/HST or PST to a recurring vendor invoice (422 india_recurring_gst); the same requests are not refused for that reason in a Canadian company

Data import: in an India company a customer state is checked against Indian states and union territories (MH accepted, BC refused under "State") and an imported customer with no country is in India; in a Canadian company BC is accepted and MH refused under "Province"

Reports: the India expense register has a GST column and no PST column or total; the Canadian one keeps GST/HST and PST; the report builder calls the customer region "State" in India and "Province" in Canada (when the builder is on)

India company in the browser: period lists say "Financial year to date" with DD-MM-YYYY dates; payroll pages show no Canadian Payroll Support notice and make no Canadian payroll call; Tax codes and GIFI open the Canada-only page; the expense page and expense register show GST and no PST
Canadian company in the browser is unchanged: "Fiscal year to date", the Payroll Support notice on payroll pages, the Tax codes page itself, and GST/HST and PST columns on expenses
